Ukraine Strikes at Russian Supply Chain

A Ukrainian strike has targeted Russian 'shadow fleet' tankers supplying Crimea. This action comes amid ongoing tensions between Ukraine and Russia. The incident highlights the complex web of supply chains supporting Russia's military operations in Ukraine.
